_doc: Registry of frontier-model system cards consumed into gzkit doctrine (chore: frontier-model-card-currency). ROTATION POLICY (operator-ruled 2026-08-02): the registry holds CURRENT cards only, one per vendor tier, plus any newer card awaiting consumption (status unconsumed). When a newer card is consumed, its entry replaces the superseded one and the superseded PDF is removed from data/system_cards/ in the same commit; superseded-model references are purged from live doctrine (re-sourced or retired), with lineage recorded in docs/governance/rule-version-history.md and git history. local_path is the retained primary-source PDF. The chore compares this registry against the vendor hubs and reports drift; it never auto-consumes a card.

vendor_hubs.anthropic: https://www.anthropic.com/news (system card announcements; PDFs linked per release)
